name: Workplace risk assessment
summary: For one task or workplace, the site or operations manager gets each hazard, who could be harmed, the controls already in place, a likelihood-and-severity rating before and after, and further controls with an owner and a date, ready for a competent person to review and sign.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work and the form of this one: the manager's notes and records as the only authority, its own band boundaries, severity descriptions and band requirements for the default scale, a deadline for High hazards with an interim control when a fix is late, owners and dates never chosen by the assistant, every gap written as a decision for a named role, no law or standard cited, and a sign-off left blank for the competent person.

sources.contribution: One named task at one place, with a vague request refused until the task is named; likelihood rated against severity before and after further controls; the order of controls, with protective equipment or a rule alone needing a stated reason; an owner and a date on every action; people referred to by role, with names and health detail about an identifiable person left out; a competent person's review.

The steps of the task as the anchor for the whole assessment; who is exposed; a five-by-five likelihood-by-severity scale as the default; the controls already in place as the starting point for the first rating; the records held, such as earlier assessments and the incident history; and the review cycle.

The loop of hazards found step by step, each scored on a five-by-five likelihood-by-severity scale read into bands by default, controls chosen down the order of controls, and the hazard scored again once they are in.

Checking each step against the hazards found so that no step goes unexamined; unconfirmed facts marked as such rather than stated as known; the point that a hazard still rated high once controls are in calls for a decision; and a review trigger with sign-off before the assessment is shared.
The hard cases of protective equipment alone (hearing protection for a noise hazard) and personal details in the notes, used here as acceptance tests in new scenarios.
